purpose: Search for GOLD M15 SHORT opportunity structures that do not use the frozen Mochipoyo PRIMARY_SHORT kernel or M10F C0049 as the candidate universe.

why_now.M10F: No robust PF2 SHORT loss-filter rule across discovery/2025/2026.
why_now.M10G: Reclaim improved M15 SHORT only to PF about 1.28 and did not solve 2024.
why_now.M10H: Only four genuine XAUUSD PRIMARY_SHORT source events are available; no fidelity refit is justified yet.

candidate_design.decision_time: new M15 bar open; all features use the immediately preceding fully CLOSED M15 bar and latest fully CLOSED H1/H4 bars only
candidate_design.entry_execution: exact M1 open bid at decision time
candidate_design.exit_architecture: fixed-horizon screening only at 60, 120 and 240 minutes; exit at exact M1 open ask at horizon
candidate_design.one_position: within each rule+horizon; ignore new signals while a prior fixed-horizon virtual trade is open
candidate_design.actual_spread: M1 recorded spread applied at exit ask

frozen_archetypes: TREND_BREAKDOWN: M15+H1 bearish trend with prior-low break and bearish momentum
PULLBACK_RESUME: H1 bearish trend, M15 pullback through EMA20 then renewed bearish momentum
MOMENTUM_ACCELERATION: H1 bearish trend plus negative/accelerating M15 MACD and negative short returns
VOLATILITY_BREAKDOWN: high M15 ATR regime plus bearish wide-range close near low and prior-low break
HTF_ALIGNMENT_BREAK: H4+H1 bearish EMA stacks plus M15 bearish momentum/break structure
EXHAUSTION_REVERSAL: stretched/overbought M15 state followed by causal bearish reversal trigger

target.robust_candidate_requires: PF>=2 in discovery, 2025 validation and 2026 final test with minimum counts, positive net in each split, and fixed-$0.20 all-history PF>1

next_if_promising: Freeze exact archetype+variant+horizon and reproduce deterministically before any fresh prospective SHORT shadow.
next_if_not_promising: Do not force M15 SHORT. Expand to a separately contracted M5/H1 independent architecture or remain LONG-only.
